experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 200 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r5, -9205357638345293825; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'vfdiv.s $vr0, $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.w $r7, $vr0, 0; and $r7, $r7, $r5; or $r7, $r7, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r7'

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency. Chain: tested op, then vpickve2gr.w+and+or+vreplgr2vr.w to restore the input pattern; the 7-cycle closure is subtracted (calibrated with vadd.b/xvadd.b). Swept 26 operand values including 0, powers of two, max, minnorm, maxsub, minsub, Inf and NaN: latency 11-17 cycles, CPI 5.9962-9. The stored experiment uses 1.0. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfdiv.s $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vfdiv.s $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vfdiv.s $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vfdiv.s $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vfdiv.s $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vfdiv.s $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vfdiv.s $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vfdiv.s $vr7, $vr15, $vr23'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput, 8 independent lanes. CPI ranges 5.9962-9 over the same 26-value sweep; the stored experiment uses 1.0.

notes: Vector variable-latency floating-point divide/modulo. Latency 10-26 cycles and throughput CPI 6-14 are data-dependent. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
